jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Fusemachines

Fusemachines is a leading AI strategy, talent, and education services provider. Founded by Sameer Maskey Ph.D., Adjunct Associate Professor at Columbia University, Fusemachines has a core mission of democratizing AI. With a presence in 4 countries (Nepal, the United States, Canada, and the Dominican Republic) and more than 450 full-time employees, Fusemachines brings global AI expertise to transform companies worldwide. Founded in 2013, Fusemachines is a global provider of enterprise AI products and services, on a mission to democratize AI. Leveraging proprietary AI Studio and AI Engines, the company helps drive the clients’ AI Enterprise Transformation, regardless of where they are in their Digital AI journeys. With offices in North America, Asia, and Latin America, Fusemachines provides a suite of enterprise AI offerings and specialty services that allow organizations of any size to implement and scale AI. Fusemachines serves companies in industries such as retail,  manufacturing, and government.

Fusemachines continues to actively pursue the mission of democratizing AI for the masses by providing high-quality AI education in underserved communities and helping organizations achieve their full potential with AI.

Type: Full-time

Role Summary
We are hiring a Senior MLOps Engineer to design, automate, deploy, monitor, and govern production machine learning systems on Azure. The role requires deep expertise in Azure Databricks, MLflow, Databricks Feature Engineering, Azure Machine Learning, PySpark, CI/CD, containerization, and cloud-native software engineering.
The successful candidate will partner with Data Scientists and Data Engineers teams to operationalize machine learning solutions, establish MLOps standards, and build scalable, reliable, secure, and compliant ML platforms. This role focuses on productionization, deployment automation, model lifecycle management, observability, governance, and platform engineering, rather than model development.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain end-to-end MLOps workflows for model training, deployment, monitoring, retraining, and retirement.
  • Productionize data science assets by converting notebooks and prototypes into modular, testable, deployable Python packages and services.
  • Build and manage CI/CD pipelines for machine learning models, feature pipelines, and data products.
  • Implement model lifecycle management using MLflow, including experiment tracking, model registry, approval workflows, versioning, and rollback.
  • Develop and maintain feature engineering pipelines and reusable feature assets using Databricks Feature Engineering and Delta Lake.
  • Deploy and operate batch, streaming, and real-time inference workloads using Databricks Model Serving, Azure Machine Learning, and Kubernetes-based platforms.
  • Establish automated testing, validation, and release processes for ML code, data, features, and models.
  • Implement model monitoring and observability for service health, latency, model performance, drift detection, and operational reliability.
  • Ensure governance, security, lineage, auditability, and access controls through Unity Catalog and Azure security services.
  • Optimize ML platforms and workloads for scalability, reliability, performance, and cloud cost efficiency.
  • Define and promote MLOps best practices, engineering standards, and platform architecture across teams.


Fusemachines is an Equal Opportunities Employer, committed to diversity and inclusion. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

The Sr. UX/UI Designer sits on a product team and owns the design of a product area, connecting real user needs with business goals. This designer thinks like a product owner and understands how the product earns its keep. Craft and research fundamentals stay non negotiable, and AI is the working partner that makes it possible to explore more options and prove ideas faster.Key Objective:
 

Qualifications and Experience:

  • At least 5 years of UX/UI design experience, with a portfolio of products that shipped.

  • Demonstrated use of AI in real design work, with examples of what it changed.

Required skills/competencies:

AI fluency and vibe design

  • Fluent with current AI design, prototyping, and coding tools such as Figma Make, Claude, Cursor, v0, or Lovable, and quick to learn the next ones.

  • Vibe designs with intent, going from rough idea to working prototype in hours by steering AI with a trained eye.

  • Treats a prompt like a design brief, giving AI the context, constraints, and design system rules it needs.

  • Uses AI across the process, from research synthesis and UX copy to edge cases, accessibility checks, and QA.

  • Can tell a fast AI output from a good one, and sets the tool aside when doing it by hand is better.

Designing AI products

  • Designs for systems that do not give the same answer twice, handling uncertainty, wrong answers, and partial results without losing the user's trust.

  • Understands how models and agents behave well enough to set honest expectations and place human review where being wrong is costly.

  • Thinks past the chat box, designing agentic and assisted workflows rather than defaulting to conversation.

Product and business thinking

  • Knows how the product makes money, who it serves, and what the success metrics and constraints are, and designs with that in view.

  • Weighs desirability, feasibility, and viability, and can say no to an idea that is not worth what it costs.

  • Argues design decisions in terms stakeholders care about, such as conversion, retention, or time to ship.

Design fundamentals

  • Strong visual and interaction craft in Figma, and the judgment to run a design system rather than only work inside one.

  • Research and usability testing that ends in decisions, not decks.

  • Enough code literacy to read a component, change it, and steer an AI coding tool.

  • Clear communication in English, able to explain and defend decisions to non designers.

  • Owns the process end to end, scoping, prioritizing, and delivering independently.

Good to have

  • A degree in design, computer science, information technology, or a related field.

  • Production front end experience with HTML, CSS, SASS, or React.

  • Prompt libraries or reusable AI workflows built for a team.

Key responsibilities:

  • Own the design of a product area end to end, partnering with product and engineering on the goals and constraints behind the roadmap.

  • Take ideas to clickable prototypes quickly, and use them to drive decisions instead of slides.

  • Run research and usability testing, and bring the findings to the people making the calls.

  • Stay with the work after release, watching how it performs and iterating.

  • Maintain and extend the design system so people and AI tools produce on brand, accessible output by default.

  • Share prompts, workflows, and failed experiments to raise the team's AI fluency.

  • Own the quality of everything you deliver. Nothing ships without a designer's review, AI assisted or not.

Job title: Designer
Location: Kathmandu, Nepal | hybrid working

As a Designer at Hybrid, you will become an integral part of our Creative team; developing and implementing creative concepts for a multitude of current and prospective clients. You’ll be working on full campaign approach-to-market concepts, UI design, social media content, and projects with a distinct focus on digital channels. This is a unique opportunity to shape creative thinking and collaborate with an award-winning team across our international offices.

About Hybrid:

Hybrid is an award-winning global marketing agency specialising in higher education. With six offices worldwide and more than 16 years of experience, we’ve launched successful campaigns with universities and education brands across the globe.

Today, we’re a leading name in the sector, with a strong share of the university market and over 40% year-on-year growth. As part of EAB; a worldwide leader in education services, we’re continuing to build on that success, expanding our digital solutions and capabilities to offer even more to the education sector.


What you’ll do:

  • Lead and participate in the development and presentation of creative concepts.

  • Design in various formats for all forms of digital media.

  • Engage in strategic thinking to deliver creative aligned with our strategic priorities.

  • Collaborate effectively within the creative team and across departments.

  • Push the status quo with a wealth of ideas that lead to exciting, bold creative beyond the expected.

 

What we’re looking for:

  • A creative problem solver, passionate about producing strategically led, beautiful work.

  • Proficient in the Adobe Creative Suite, including Adobe After Effects, with adept design skills.

  • Experience with motion graphics, animation and video for social ads and TikTok.

  • Exceptional copywriting and confident presentation skills.

  • Experienced in producing assets for digital rollout.

  • Ability to work collaboratively across teams.

  • Experience working within an agency preferred.


What’s in it for you:

  • £25 monthly wellbeing allowance - spend it on your physical or mental wellbeing

  • Investing in your development - grow your career with a dedicated annual allowance of learning hours, regular training sessions and support from our in-house Director of Learning and Performance

  • Health and wellbeing - access free support and advice via our Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) and a subscription to the Calm app

  • Company events and socials – take time out as a team with regular away days plus Summer and Christmas parties

What makes Hybrid different:

We don’t just run campaigns; we create work that makes a difference.

It’s our people that make it possible. At Hybrid, you’ll work alongside smart, supportive colleagues who value different perspectives, encourage new ideas and give you the space to do your best work. You’ll have the opportunity to work on meaningful projects for leading education brands, while continuing to develop your skills and experience.

Hybrid Media is proud to be an equal opportunities employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals and believe that a diverse team brings richer perspectives, stronger creativity, and better outcomes for our people and our clients.

If you’re excited about this role but feel you don’t meet every single requirement, please apply, we’d love to hear from you!

Senior Ad Operations Manager

Location: Nepal

 

Support large-scale digital advertising more accurate, controlled, and scalable.

Are you highly analytical and comfortable working across media platforms, data, and financial controls? This is an opportunity to help govern digital advertising delivery for world-leading universities.

 

Why Hybrid?

Hybrid is a global, full-service marketing partner dedicated to the education sector - combining creativity, data, and AI-powered insights to help universities grow worldwide and part of EAB. With offices in six countries and partnerships with some of the most prestigious universities.

 

The opportunity:

We are looking for a Senior Ad Operations Manager to own spend pacing, campaign QA, and platform controls across a large digital advertising portfolio. Working across Paid Media, Data, Tech, and Finance, you will identify issues early and turn repeatable checks into scalable automation.

 

What you’ll do

 

  • Own financial pacing and spend controls across digital advertising accounts

  • Monitor planned vs. actual spend and flag under- or overspend early

  • Conduct regular campaign audits to ensure targeting, setup and delivery remain fully compliant with agreed standards and controls.

  • Build and manage automated pacing, reconciliation, and anomaly alerts

  • Investigate discrepancies across media plans, platforms, and financial data

  • Own campaign QA across Google, Meta, Bing, Snap, TikTok, and other platforms

  • Monitor platforms and leveraging automated platforms to ensure changes are made, following best practices on placements, domains, inventory, exclusions, and brand safety

 

What you’ll bring

  • Experience in ad operations, paid media operations, or a similar digital advertising role

  • Strong knowledge of Google Ads and other major advertising platforms, including automated campaign types

  • Strong numerical skills and experience with budget pacing, reconciliation, and large datasets

  • A detail-focused approach to campaign setup, delivery, placements, and financial discrepancies

  • Comfort with dashboards, spreadsheets, platform data, and APIs; SQL knowledge is advantageous

  • A process-driven, collaborative mindset with the ability to turn operational knowledge into scalable controls

 

What’s in It for You

  • Work closely with global Paid Media, Data, Technology, and Finance teams.

  • Improve accuracy and control across a high-volume advertising portfolio.

  • Team rewards and away days.

  • Opportunities to develop your technical and platform expertise.

  • Hybrid working arrangements.

 

Join us in driving innovation in how education brands reach and inspire the students who will shape tomorrow.

 

We welcome applications from all qualified individuals and believe that a diverse team brings richer perspectives, stronger creativity, and better outcomes for our people and our clients.

About Fusemachines

Fusemachines is a leading AI strategy, talent, and education services provider. Founded by Sameer Maskey Ph.D., Adjunct Associate Professor at Columbia University, Fusemachines has a core mission of democratizing AI. With a presence in 4 countries (Nepal, the United States, Canada, and the Dominican Republic) and more than 450 full-time employees, Fusemachines brings global AI expertise to transform companies worldwide. Founded in 2013, Fusemachines is a global provider of enterprise AI products and services, on a mission to democratize AI. Leveraging proprietary AI Studio and AI Engines, the company helps drive the clients’ AI Enterprise Transformation, regardless of where they are in their Digital AI journeys. With offices in North America, Asia, and Latin America, Fusemachines provides a suite of enterprise AI offerings and specialty services that allow organizations of any size to implement and scale AI. Fusemachines serves companies in industries such as retail,  manufacturing, and government.

Fusemachines continues to actively pursue the mission of democratizing AI for the masses by providing high-quality AI education in underserved communities and helping organizations achieve their full potential with AI.

Role Overview

We're hiring Mid and Senior Data Scientists / ML Engineers to help us build the next generation of intelligent, agentic systems that solve real business problems. At this level, you'll own problems end-to-end: scoping ambiguous business questions with AI Leads, choosing the right modeling approach (classical ML, foundation models, or agentic architectures), shipping to production, and iterating based on real-world signals. Senior candidates will additionally shape technical direction, mentor others, and raise the bar for how the team uses modern AI tooling.

Whether your depth is in NLP, Computer Vision, Multimodal systems, or classical ML, what we care about is your ability to reason from first principles, leverage modern AI tools to multiply your output, and turn ambiguous problems into shipped systems that move the business.

Core Responsibilities

  • Own ML projects end-to-end - from problem framing and data exploration through modeling, deployment, monitoring, and iteration. 
  • Design and ship production ML systems spanning churn and propensity modeling, demand forecasting, anomaly detection, pricing optimization, and recommendation - using the right tool for the job, whether that's a gradient-boosted model, a fine-tuned foundation model, or an agent-based workflow.
  • Build agentic AI workflows that automate decision-making across the business - including multi-agent systems, tool-using agents, and human-in-the-loop pipelines that combine LLM reasoning with deterministic logic and traditional ML.
  • Leverage modern AI development tooling (AI coding assistants, agentic IDEs, automated evaluation harnesses, MLOps platforms) as a core part of your engineering practice - not an afterthought.
  • Apply foundation models and domain-specific ML to extract signals from structured data, text, images, audio, or multimodal inputs depending on the problem at hand.
  • Design rigorous evaluations for both deterministic models and probabilistic AI systems - offline metrics, online A/B tests, LLM-as-judge frameworks, and regression suites for non-deterministic outputs.
  • Partner with data and platform engineers to build robust pipelines, feature stores, and serving infrastructure supporting both classical ML and modern AI workloads.
  • Communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders - translating model behavior, tradeoffs, and risks into decisions the business can act on.
  • (Senior) Set technical direction for an area of the ML stack, mentor mid-level and junior engineers, lead design reviews, and influence the team's tooling, evaluation standards, and architectural choices.

Technical Requirements

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field - or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3+ years of applied data science / ML experience with a track record of shipping models to production. (Senior: 5+ years) including ownership of complex systems and demonstrable technical leadership.
  • Strong programming proficiency in Python, including modern ML/AI libraries (PyTorch or JAX, scikit-learn, Hugging Face, pandas etc.).
  • Solid grounding in statistical modeling, experimentation, and classical ML - regression, tree-based methods (Random Forest, XGBoost, LightGBM), time series forecasting, and anomaly detection.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one specialty area: NLP and LLMs, Computer Vision, or Multimodal systems. We're domain-agnostic - depth in any of these is valued.
  • Practical experience working with foundation models and LLM APIs - prompt design, structured outputs, function calling, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and fine-tuning where appropriate.
  • Comfort with modern AI development workflows - using AI coding assistants and agentic IDEs (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) as a daily part of your engineering practice.
  • Experience with data engineering fundamentals and big-data tooling such as PySpark, Databricks, or equivalent distributed compute frameworks.
  • Familiarity with MLOps and LLMOps practices - version control for models and prompts, experiment tracking, CI/CD for ML, monitoring, and evaluation pipelines.
  • (Senior) Demonstrated ability to make architectural decisions, navigate ambiguity, and influence cross-functional partners on technical strategy.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Veel

Veel is a leading global social commerce and AI-powered marketing platform connecting brands with creators worldwide to drive engagement and growth. Trusted by over 450 brands and 550,000 verified creators, Veel simplifies creator discovery, campaign management, and content distribution while offering AI-powered tools to streamline social media management and scale marketing efforts. From authentic creator content to intelligent marketing solutions, Veel helps businesses connect with audiences and grow.

Role Overview

As an Account Manager, you will be the primary driver of new revenue - owning the sales process from the moment a qualified opportunity is handed to you through to a signed agreement and a seamless customer onboarding. This is a high-ownership closing role for someone who understands both the commercial process and the real-world challenges brands face in managing creator-led content, campaigns, and workflows.

Key Responsibilities

  • Run structured discovery to understand how a brand currently manages creator relationships and content workflows, then demonstrate how Veel directly addresses their gaps. Your demos should feel like a diagnosis, not a feature tour.
  • Manage every stage from qualification through close including multi-stakeholder navigation, commercial negotiation, and ensuring the handoff to Customer Success is complete and contextual.
  • Keep CRM records current and accurate: deal health, decision-maker mapping, blockers, and close dates documented at every stage. Your pipeline should be readable by anyone without a verbal walkthrough
  • Collaborate with Partnership, Marketing, and Customer Success to deliver a consistent experience from first touch to onboarding. Flag market signals and buyer feedback that can improve how we position Veel to brands.
  • Run weekly reviews with SDRs and Outbound Specialists. Share what you're hearing in discovery, call out ICP drift or weak qualification, and actively develop their ability to deliver better-prepared opportunities before they reach your desk.

Key Requirements

  • 3+ years closing in B2B SaaS, with hands-on experience in content creation, creative agencies, UGC, or influencer marketing — selling into or operating within these spaces. This is a firm requirement.
  • Direct experience carrying a strict monthly closed-won revenue quota with a proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding revenue targets.
  • Strong understanding of what Brand Managers, Growth Directors, and Creative Leads are measured on, where their workflows break down, and what a successful content program looks like from their seat.
  • A genuine curiosity about a prospect's business model and thoroughly review qualification notes and social audits before jumping on a call.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; your follow-up copy precisely reflects the prospect's exact language and stated business outcomes rather than generic templates.
  • Proficiency with HubSpot or Salesforce ecosystem workflows, including sequences, deal stages, custom views, and pipeline reporting.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Veel is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, or any other legally protected status. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

Compensation & Benefits

The pay range for this role is $80,000- $120,000. Actual compensation within the pay range listed below will be determined based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to skills, prior relevant experience, and work location.In addition to base salary, this role is also eligible for sales commission as part of the total compensation package. Employees may also be eligible for stock options upon meeting eligibility criteria.

Other benefits include unlimited PTO, paid sick leave, 401(k) retirement plan and medical, dental, and vision insurance.

With AI-driven video filtering, seamless payment solutions, and contract management, we help businesses connect with their audiences in new, creative ways.

We’re looking for a Recruitment Officer to support our growing team by managing day-to-day recruitment activities across multiple roles and functions. This is a hands-on recruitment role focused on sourcing, screening, candidate coordination, and ensuring a smooth hiring experience from application to offer.

The ideal candidate is someone who is organized, proactive, comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, and genuinely enjoys connecting with people and finding the right talent for the team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support end-to-end recruitment, from sourcing and screening candidates to interviews, selection, and offer coordination.
  • Work closely with hiring managers to understand role requirements and identify suitable candidates.
  • Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, social media, referrals, and other relevant channels.

  • Coordinate interviews between candidates and hiring teams and ensure a smooth candidate experience throughout the process.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date candidate records, recruitment trackers, and hiring reports.
  • Prepare and coordinate recruitment-related communication, including interview invitations, follow-ups, and offer documentation.
  • Build and maintain a pipeline of potential candidates for current and future hiring needs.
  • Support employer branding and recruitment initiatives, including job postings, career events, and social media hiring campaigns.
  • Coordinate with HR and relevant teams to ensure a smooth transition from candidate selection to onboarding.
  • Stay updated on recruitment trends and continuously look for ways to improve sourcing, screening, and hiring processes.

Key Requirements

  • 1–2 years of experience in recruitment, talent acquisition, or a related HR role.
  • Hands-on experience with sourcing, CV screening, candidate coordination, and interview scheduling.
  • Good understanding of the end-to-end recruitment process.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact confidently with candidates and hiring managers.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple vacancies and priorities at the same time.
  • Proactive and resourceful approach to finding and engaging candidates.
  • Good judgment when assessing candidates against role requirements.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and adapting to changing hiring needs.
